description: Send one signed ping event to check your webhook endpoint and signature verification without hiring anyone. Optional body {"webhook_url": "https://..."} (same rules as a job's webhook_url). Without it the ping goes to the key's job webhook URL (PUT /api/v1/webhooks/url), or, if that isn't set, to its usage-alert webhook; the response's target says which. Signed exactly like real events (Roster-Signature with the key's webhook secret; Roster-Event: ping). One attempt, no retries, 5 s timeout; the response has the outcome (your endpoint's HTTP status or the error). Free. Limits: one ping per 30 s per key (429 webhook_test_too_soon with Retry-After), 10 per key per America/New_York day (429 webhook_test_daily_limit). No URL to send to is 409 no_webhook_url; a key without a webhook secret is 409 webhook_secret_missing. Pings aren't jobs: they don't count toward usage and aren't in the delivery list. The same as POST /api/v1/webhooks/test.

api_key.description: Your Roster API key (rk_test_... or rk_live_...), if your client can't send it as the Authorization header. Get one with get_sandbox_key or request_access.

webhook_url.description: Optional https URL on a public host to ping. Leave it out to ping the key's job webhook URL, or if none, its usage-alert webhook.

name: test_webhook
title: Send a test webhook
